defaults_policy: NONE; null means AUTHORIAL_SELECTION_REQUIRED and blocks materialization of dependent fields.

choices.physical_meaning: Long-wavelength residual ocean-floor elevation after any explicitly selected age-derived thermal/isostatic component; separate authority tags for model component, authored residual and unknown fine relief.
choices.allowed_support: Ocean domain only; support derived from authorized physical ocean/crust-domain geometry, never assigned from plate identity alone.
choices.allowed_constraint_or_range: Range/domain constrained relative to the canonical R6 sea-level datum; coherent basin/domain field or feature template; sparse relief only when physically authored and sourced.

choices.physical_meaning: Physical structural domain geometry and parameterized crust-thickness distributions for oceanic, continental and explicitly supported transitional structure.
choices.allowed_support: Canonical spherical surface partition/support; domain IDs distinct from plate IDs; no land/ocean equivalence assumed.
choices.allowed_constraint_or_range: Positive thickness, ordered layers, model/material constrained distributions, domain-coherent transitions; no numeric ARCANA values selected.
downstream_effects: FEG element material groups if later authorized

choices.physical_meaning: Age at T0 of the explicitly declared oceanic lithosphere support.
choices.allowed_support: Oceanic lithosphere domains; explicit UNKNOWN mask where age is undefined or not authored.
choices.allowed_constraint_or_range: Nonnegative age measured before T0=210 Ma; age surfaces must be coherent with declared source chronology or selected low-dimensional field model.

choices.physical_meaning: Continental structural-domain support and compact domain-wise thermal/geotherm family, with heat-production family only where the chosen model requires it.
choices.allowed_support: Explicit physical continental domains independent of land mask, plate ID or design province tags.
choices.allowed_constraint_or_range: Domain-class constrained profiles/distributions; explicit surface and basal conditions; thermal flux and conductivity consistency.

non_primitive_design_selections.note: Select source-bound parameter distributions and cross-parameter constraints; do not copy iEarth example values.
Select physically admissible model configurations; no Earth OrbScore optimum may stand in for ARCANA authority.
Must be reconciled to exact pinned Shells `.bcs` semantics and a declared ARCANA kinematic frame; must not prescribe every node's solution velocity.
Choose and validate a spherical FEG producer, with branch/junction preservation and a refinement-convergence plan.
